mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.work_start_time, c.work_end_time, c.late_grace_minutes, c.early_leave_grace_minutes, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, u.nickname AS updatedByName FROM att_work_config c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.updated_by WHERE c.id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE att_work_config SET work_start_time = #{c.workStartTime}, work_end_time = #{c.workEndTime}, late_grace_minutes = #{c.lateGraceMinutes}, early_leave_grace_minutes = #{c.earlyLeaveGraceMinutes}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{c.updatedBy} WHERE id = 1
